# GitHub Copilot instructions for Ketcher

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. It holds the project overview, the commands, and the rules for every AI tool in this repository.

Review comments follow the output contract in [review-workflow.md](../.memory-bank/review-workflow.md#output-contract). The rules that a review applies are in [review-rules.md](../.memory-bank/review-rules.md). Patterns that reviewers do not raise are in [accepted-patterns.md](../.memory-bank/accepted-patterns.md).
